issues.text: Round-1 issue came back in a new form: the last sentence of explanation d adds a rule the lesson never taught (the product owner stopping a sprint when its goal no longer makes sense). The rest of d is clear without it; the extra sentence reads as a new idea, not a correction.
issues.quote: Stopping fits only when the product owner decides the sprint goal itself no longer makes sense.
issues.fix: Delete this last sentence from explanation.en.d (and its vi mirror), ending d at "...it does not ask the team to stop the sprint for a new request."

issues.text: Option c is now paraphrased (round-1 issue fixed), but it is by far the longest option, almost twice a and b, so it can be picked by length alone.
issues.quote: False, because the team can agree changes with the Product Owner while the sprint's goal stays safe.
issues.fix: Shorten c, e.g. "False: changes agreed with the Product Owner are fine if the goal stays safe.", or lengthen a and b by a clause each.

issues.text: Round-1 wording fixed, but explanation d still points to 'the two items' of the refund plan; the schedule-buffer summary I know only says the buffer is 8 days, not which items it covers, so I stop to wonder which two.
issues.quote: The refund plan's buffer is in days, for the two items estimated with three-point estimation, and it is not room for new work anyway.
issues.fix: Drop "for the two items estimated with three-point estimation," so d reads "The refund plan's buffer is in days, and it is not room for new work anyway." (mirror in vi).
